title: Claude Code auto mode is out. And most people are about to miss the real question.
description:
Claude Code auto mode is out. And most people are about to miss the real question.

It's not "is the model good enough?" It's "do you have a HITL map for what this agent decides autonomously?"

Auto mode delegates the human-in-the-loop trigger to the model itself. That's a governance shift — not just a productivity upgrade.

Before you enable it: map your decision paths. Set confidence thresholds. Wire your circuit breakers.

The tool isn't the risk. The architecture is.

#ClaudeCode #AIAgents #AgenticAI #AIGovernance #HITL
